historical_reviews.deepseek: The wrapper can corroborate decoding but not raw coverage, target provenance or safe credential handling.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly retains a read-only automated classification and OOB-specific evidence.
historical_reviews.history: The invalidated prior-run location was found but excluded as authority; the IB twin and upcoming setter were examined only to preserve path and mutation boundaries.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The asset tag is itself an identity claim and therefore cannot be the only evidence that the network endpoint is the intended SUT.

original_test_intent: Read the programmed DCMI asset tag over a verified OOB session and prove that the complete value belongs to and matches the authoritative target asset record.
original_method: Execute the LANPlus raw 0x2c 0x06 0xdc 0 0x10 request on an independently identified BMC, validate its response and use only documented bounded continuation when completeness requires it.
manual_activity: No hands-on action is required; the project supplies endpoint policy and the authoritative asset record, while the end user decides the final result.
required_inputs: Verified BMC IP, firmware and immutable SUT identity
Expected asset tag and normalization rules
safety_requirements: Bind endpoint independently of tag value
Do not issue tag or FRU writes
engineer_actions: Supply immutable target and authoritative asset expectations

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level command omits the raw request/response structure and password argv can leak credentials, so it is supplemental rather than authoritative.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using protected credentials on the verified BMC, run LANPlus raw 0x2c 0x06 0xdc 0 0x10, validate completeness/encoding and compare the exact asset tag with inventory.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The OOB route, exact request and 10/5 timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a secret-safe OOB reader that anchors the BMC independently, retains raw bytes and compares a complete normalized tag with the authoritative FRU/inventory record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds endpoint provenance, secret controls and semantic acceptance without altering the read command.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: IB evidence does not cover LANPlus routing/authentication, and a high-level string can hide truncated or malformed bytes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong-endpoint or truncated-tag matches can associate all later evidence with the wrong physical asset.

project_override_considerations: Redfish/FRU/high-level views may cross-check the tag, but raw OOB coverage remains unless equivalence, completeness and session identity are proven.
expected_evidence: Completion, length, encoding, terminator and completeness checks

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master title, FRU precondition and OOB 0x06 getter agree. Its success-only criterion is incomplete rather than contradictory; DeepSeek transport and credential deficiencies are overlay issues.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read operation and field are explicit. Endpoint, credentials, decoder and inventory are ordinary project inputs.

review_improvement: Adds independent remote-target provenance and complete asset comparison to an otherwise syntactic raw query.
independent_technical_reasoning: A remote asset-tag result combines two identity layers: the session endpoint and the tag stored in FRU/BMC metadata. Both must agree with an independent asset record. By anchoring the endpoint first and then validating complete raw tag bytes, automation avoids circularly trusting the value under test to identify its own source.
